common.tagline: The Carbon Credit Standard. Verified. Onchain. DeFi-native.

earth.lead: CCM is the standard unit for one verifiably reduced ton of CO₂. Onchain. DeFi-native. PPM measures concentration; CCM measures avoidance.

measure.label: Measure
measure.title: Physics over paperwork.
measure.body: Satellites, IoT sensors, LiDAR. Every reduction is timestamped, signed, and verifiable end-to-end.

verify.label: Verify
verify.title: M-of-N validator consensus.
verify.body: Stake-bonded VVB network. Wrong attestations are slashed. ZK-proofs for sensitive data.

retire.label: Retire
retire.title: One token, one ton, retired once.
retire.body: Globally unique CCM-NFTs. Once burned, the certificate is non-transferable and audit-ready.

ccmine.lead: Proof of Carbon Removal/Reduction (PoCR). Operate hardware, attest data, or store registry shards — earn from every verified ton.

tokenomics.lead: 5,000,000,000 hard cap. ERC20Capped enforced. 40% to mining, 9% liquidity, 18% foundation. veCCM accrues protocol revenue.

roadmap.lead: From Standard v1.0 to UNFCCC Article 6 alignment. Phase 0 done. Mainnet 2026 Q3. DeFi at scale 2027 H1.

defi.lead: Wrap, vault, lend, fractionalize, retire, insure, index. CCM × DeFi composability — Uniswap, Curve, Aave, Pendle, OpenSea, Sudoswap.

markets.lead: CCM series price discovery, your holdings, recent activity.
